text: Quick question—if I’m setting up two events in Accelevents, can I have both open in different tabs? Or is that going to mess something up?

Hey Tom, yeah, actually you shouldn’t do that. There’s a note in the handbook about not having multiple events open in the same browser—it can mess with the cache and settings might get crossed between events.
Ah, got it. So just one event per browser window then?

Exactly, just stick to one event at a time in your browser. If you really need to have two open, you could try using a different browser or incognito mode for the second one, but safest is just one at a time.
Makes sense, thanks Sara! I’ll stick to one. Appreciate it.
